pin_solo._about: THE live rule since v2.0, widened v2.1 (Matt, 2026-10-28 11:52 AM): between two consecutive reads Pinnacle's de-vigged chance on Hard Rock's main line (same line on both reads at Hard Rock and Pinnacle) moves >= min_move toward a side while the median move of the other books (same line, both reads, >= others_min books) toward that side is < others_max (2 pts); bet that side at Hard Rock's price on the later read (flag_reads only, read <= max_age_min old). Discovery Oct 25-27: 31 bets 22-9 +9.74u (16 alone 11-5 + 15 with others 1-2 pts 11-4). v2.2 (Matt, 2026-10-28 6:10 PM): Hard Rock's price on that side must also be >= min_gap_vs_pin (2 pts of break-even, ~10 cents) better than Pinnacle's new posted price (Bane O2.5 threes: HR -140 vs Pinnacle -134). Replay at 2 pts: 13 bets 10-3 +5.87u.
